text:
Iris Kim: Heads up — ElmCare reported a renewal discrepancy. They say an HSM add-on was billed twice and a platform promo was applied twice on invoice 100212.
Diego Ramos: Ugh. Can you paste the invoice lines? I'll pull the PDF.
Iris Kim: Snippet:
```
Invoice 100212
- Private deployment license: $72,000
- Platform fee: $11,000
- Platform promo credit: -$2,200
- Platform promo credit (duplicate): -$2,200
- HSM managed keys: $4,000
- HSM managed keys (duplicate): $4,000
- Support (Enterprise): $18,000
Total: $103,600
```
BillingBot: (automated) Received dispute for invoice 100212. Running duplicate detection. Found duplicate HSM line and duplicate credit memos from legacy import. Opening case BLG-2026-478. Recommending single consolidated credit note.
Diego Ramos: If one is an extra charge and one is an extra credit they nearly cancel but net is +$3,600 credit to the customer. We should offer a single CN for $3,600 unless customer wants separate line items.
Revenue Ops - Ben: Standard practice: issue CN applied to next invoice unless customer requests refund. Approve CN-5710 for $3,600. Finance to process if refund requested.
Legal - Priya: Confirming contract allows correction. Suggest neutral wording for customer: "We identified an internal billing duplication on your renewal and issued a corrective credit note for $3,600. Attached is a corrected invoice and the credit note. Please let us know if you prefer a cash refund."
Iris Kim: I'll reply to ElmCare with that text and ask refund vs credit preference. Diego, can you reissue corrected invoice PDF after CN is created?
Diego Ramos: Yup. Will regenerate invoice and upload corrected PDF here. BillingBot — tag CN when ready.
BillingBot: (automated) Credit note CN-5710 created (pending application). Case BLG-2026-478 updated. Notifying Revenue Ops and Finance.
Iris Kim: Customer replied, prefers credit to next invoice. Proceeding to apply CN-5710 and reissue invoice. Closing once PDF posted.
Diego Ramos: Uploaded corrected invoice + CN PDF. Reconciliation: original total 103,600 -> corrected total 100,000 after CN application. I'll attach final ledger entries to the case.
Iris Kim: Thanks all :thumbsup:
